summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a detailed lecture on the proper technique and etiquette of sujud (prostration) in Islamic prayer, specifically focusing on the description of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) manner of performing sujud. Sh. Ali Mashhour explains the correct sequence of body parts that should touch the ground during prostration—the seven limbs as mentioned in hadith: the forehead, nose, hands, knees, and tips of the feet. He emphasizes scholarly discussions regarding whether one should descend on the knees first or hands first, citing various interpretations and the differences of opinion among Islamic scholars.
suggested_title: The Seven Limbs of Sujud: Detailed Explanation of Proper Prostration in Prayer
catchy_title: What Makes Sujud Valid and Complete?
